messages:
Aisha K: Hi @people-ops / confidential: I start a short course of radiation therapy next week (morning appointments M/W/F for 3 weeks). I'll have fatigue and can't reliably commute on treatment days. Can we arrange predictable WFH those mornings and a temporary meeting-window accommodation? Please keep medical details private.

Lee (People Ops): Thanks for the heads-up, Aisha  we can absolutely support that. Two quick Qs: do you want fully remote mornings (e.g., 8amnoon) or flexible login times on appointment days? We can also ship a small stiped for quiet workspace if commuting is unsafe. I will DM the confidential intake link and open a case.

Aisha K: Appreciate it. Full WFH mornings 8amnoon on treatment days would be best plus a short "no-meet" block 8am11am for 3 weeks. Stipend not needed. Will fill the intake now  prefer only manager and People Ops involved.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case created: AC-2026-6891. Lee assigned. Private intake link DM'd.

Rosa (Manager): Aisha  I fully support this and thank you for telling us. I'll mark your calendar as "WFH - medical accommodation" on those dates and cover any required standups. I will not include medical details in any team messages.

Lee (People Ops): Intake received. Proposed interim accommodations: 1) Approved WFH mornings 8amnoon on 2026-06-07, 2026-06-09, 2026-06-11 (and following weeks MWF for 3 weeks), 2) Manager notification redacted to "temporary WFH schedule approved", 3) Exclude affected mornings from deep-focus metric calculations. Will check in after week 1 to reassess.

Aisha K: Thank you both  that's perfect. I also asked to avoid scheduling interviews during 8am11am where possible.

Rosa (Manager): Noted. I'll remove Aisha from early interview panels and add a team note to avoid scheduling 8am11am. I'll also log a short performance note so nothing flags in the quarter.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7 days for AC-2026-6891.
